summary: Space Graveyard is an interactive digital museum about NASA spacecraft left behind on the Moon, Mars and in deep space. Visitors can browse eight missions, read each spacecraft’s profile, and hear its story in its own first-person voice. It’s built for school students and casual space fans.
details:
Space Graveyard is an interactive online museum of NASA spacecraft left on the Moon, Mars and in deep space. Visitors browse eight missions and hear six of them tell their own story. It is built for school students and space fans.

What it does: Visitors search and filter the collection by location and status. Each spacecraft has a profile with dates, discoveries, a timeline and what happened to it. Story Mode retells six missions in the first person across seven chapters.

It makes mission history approachable and labels each spacecraft’s real status (completed, inactive, lost contact or still operating) instead of calling everything abandoned. We want students to see these machines as explorers whose science still matters.

Tools: React, JavaScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Lucide icons and React Router. Data is stored locally, photos come from NASA’s Image and Video Library, and it is hosted on Vercel.

Creativity: Each spacecraft has a first-person voice, clearly labelled as a creative retelling. The design is cinematic, with real NASA photography.
